# AI Builds Navies — Clone Naval Supplies Buildings
#
# Clones of vanilla naval supplies buildings with additional
# production methods for copper, iron, and timber alternatives.
# Vanilla buildings are disabled via INJECT and swapped monthly.
#
# Generated by tools/calculate_maintenance.py

# clone of naval_supplies_guild

wpdo_naval_supplies_guild = {
	icon = naval_supplies_guild
	is_foreign = no
	pop_type = burghers
	max_levels = guild_max_level
	category = weapons_industry_category
	employment_size = guild_employment
	town = yes
	city = yes
	important_for_AI = yes
	build_time = guild_build_time

	unique_production_methods = {
		wpdo_naval_supplies_guild_maintenance = {
			lumber = 0.15
			fiber_crops = 0.5
			tar = 0.5
			copper = 0.1
			tin = 0.02
			produced = naval_supplies
			output = 1.0

			potential = {
				modifier:wpdo_standard_naval_provisioning = yes
			}

			category = guild_input
		}

		wpdo_copper_sheathing_naval_supplies_guild_maintenance = {
			lumber = 0.23
			fiber_crops = 0.29
			tar = 0.29
			copper = 0.27
			produced = naval_supplies
			output = 1.0

			potential = {
				modifier:wpdo_can_produce_copper_naval_supplies = yes
			}

			category = guild_input
		}

		wpdo_iron_reinforcement_naval_supplies_guild_maintenance = {
			lumber = 0.23
			fiber_crops = 0.29
			tar = 0.29
			iron = 0.27
			produced = naval_supplies
			output = 1.0

			potential = {
				modifier:wpdo_can_produce_iron_naval_supplies = yes
			}

			category = guild_input
		}

		wpdo_timber_provisioning_naval_supplies_guild_maintenance = {
			lumber = 0.26
			fiber_crops = 0.23
			tar = 0.23
			produced = naval_supplies
			output = 0.5

			category = guild_input
		}
	}

	custom_tags = { guild }

	construction_demand = guild_construction
}

	town = no
